name: Plattekill Mountain

source.note: Piste reference data — confirm at source. Approximate base-lodge position west of Roxbury (Delaware County).

Search summary (2026-09-30): summit 3,500 ft, base 2,400 ft, vertical 1,100 ft (converted to metres). Page-level attribution not isolated (NYSkiBlog/iSkiNY/Wikipedia results). Official homepage (fetched 2026-10-03) confirms "41 exciting trails and 1100′ of vertical".

weatherPoints.label: Plattekill summit, top of the lifts (approx.)

source.note: Search summary (2026-09-30): 41 trails, 110 skiable acres, longest trail 2 miles, 4 lifts — two lifts serving the peaks (stored as chairlifts) and two surface lifts, one at the beginner area and one in the snowtubing park. Average snowfall 175 in.

features.beginnerArea: Beginner area served by its own surface lift

source.note: Search summary (2026-09-30): 75% snowmaking; a snowtubing park with its own surface lift.

character: A Catskills ski area near Roxbury in Delaware County with about 1,100 ft of vertical below a 3,500 ft summit. Its 41 trails and 110 acres are served by two lifts to the peaks plus surface lifts at the beginner area and the snowtubing park.
learning: A surface lift serves the beginner area (search summary). Lessons and rentals were not researched — confirm at source.

announcedOpening.text: Tentative opening day is slated for Saturday, December 12 (2026/27 season).

source.note: Official trail report page (fetched 2026-10-03): "gearing up for another AWESOME SEASON on the mountain for 2026/27 ... Tentative opening day is slated for Saturday, December 12."

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Dec 12, 2026 (a third-party projection, not an announcement). Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.
